name: Wilfried Helmut
original_name: ヴィルフリート・ヘルムート
source: A noble of the Empire. As a military instructor, he was a part of a team. He was asked to take responsibility for the destruction of his team and was assigned a mission. A specialist who manipulates opponents with words and actions rather than military force.
